# Interns in Asia

> Interns in Asia (AIP) connects international students and professionals with customized internship opportunities across 20+ destinations in Asia, Europe, and Oceania.

The platform specializes in career development and cultural immersion through structured internship programs in emerging and developed markets. With a focus on Southeast Asia, the program offers placements across diverse sectors including tech, finance, hospitality, engineering, and NGO work.

## Core Programs

- [Asia Internship Program | Customized internships in Asia](https://www.internsinasia.com): Homepage for Asia Internship Program offering customized internships
- [Find your International Internship Program Destinations | AIP](https://www.internsinasia.com/destinations): Main destinations finder for AIP internship programs across 18+ countries
- [Explore our Remote Internships Program | AIP](https://www.internsinasia.com/destination/remote-internships): AIP remote internships program allowing work from anywhere

## Southeast Asia Destinations

- [Internship in Thailand - AIP International Program](https://www.internsinasia.com/destination/thailand-internship): Thailand internship in Bangkok and Chiang Mai for career development
- [Internship in Vietnam | AIP International Program](https://www.internsinasia.com/destination/vietnam-internship): Vietnam internship in Ho Chi Minh and Hanoi in emerging markets
- [Internship in Indonesia | AIP International Program](https://www.internsinasia.com/destination/indonesia-internship): Customized Indonesia internship in Bali and Jakarta for students
- [Internship in Malaysia | AIP International Program](https://www.internsinasia.com/destination/malaysia-internship): Malaysia internship program for career development in Southeast Asia
- [Internship in the Philippines | AIP International Program](https://www.internsinasia.com/destination/philippines): Philippines internship program for international career development
